question: Who among the following wrote the song Vande Mataram?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay wrote the song Vande Mataram in his novel Anandamath in 1882.**
 
• The song became popular during the Indian independence movement and was adopted as the national song of India in 1950.
 
• Anil Chandra Banerjee was a Bengali poet and writer, but he did not write Vande Mataram.
 
• Lal Makhan Singh was a freedom fighter from Manipur, but he was not the author of Vande Mataram.
 
• Vir Singh Salgaonka was a poet and writer from Punjab, but he did not write Vande Mataram.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Vande Mataram means **"I bow to thee, Mother" and is a hymn to the goddess Durga.**
 
• Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay was a prominent Bengali writer and journalist who also wrote novels like **Durgesh Nandini and Devi Chaudhurani.**
 
• Anil Chandra Banerjee was known for his patriotic poems and songs, but he did not write Vande Mataram.
 
• Lal Makhan Singh was a member of the Indian National Army and fought against the British, but he did not write Vande Mataram.
 
• Vir Singh Salgaonka was a Punjabi poet and writer who wrote about Sikhism and Punjabi culture, but he did not write Vande Mataram.
